title: The Olde Pink House

buildingCutout.basis: The individually named mapped house on Abercorn Street.

terrainReference.basis: Original sidewalk elevation between the porch and Abercorn Street.

mapIdentity.scope: Surveyed map outline, named historic inventory and two exact publicly released Historic American Buildings Survey photographs.

note: The stuccoed brick house has two storeys over a basement, end parapets and chimneys, slate gable, corner quoins, regular six-over-six windows with metal hoods and a Palladian window over the balustraded Doric entrance porch.
